metaTitle: Custom Recycled PET Lanyards | Perfect Imprints
metaDescription: Order custom recycled PET lanyards for your next event or trade show. Eco-friendly, durable, and made in the USA. Get a quote at Perfect Imprints.
introHtml: Recycled PET lanyards are made from post-consumer plastic bottles, making them a sustainable choice for eco-conscious organizations. They offer the same durability and vibrant printability as virgin polyester, with the added benefit of reducing waste. Perfect for trade shows, conferences, or employee ID badges, these lanyards can be fully sublimated with your logo or message. Choose recycled PET to demonstrate your commitment to the environment without sacrificing quality or appearance.
heroAltText: Custom recycled PET lanyards with full-color sublimated print, displayed on a white background
